dedupe_keys.name: seco cross border building risk data chain

description: The SECO Building Intelligence repository publishes a Python and Streamlit preparation chain for building-level risk context across France, Luxembourg and Belgium. The publisher documents joins between French energy performance certificates, the national building register, BDNB attributes and clay-shrinkage exposure; it also includes Luxembourg and Belgian geospatial examples. Its public tree contains prepared CSV and GeoJSON samples, synthetic inspection reports and an AQC pathology-sheet text corpus. The README says all demo data ship locally, so the interface can be viewed without API keys; optional language-model drafting uses external services. The MIT repository licence covers code, while each government source and AQC document has separate terms. The review did not execute joins or verify the reported classifier scores or source coverage. Simulation use includes assembling per-building exposure and condition attributes for a building-stock risk model, with synthetic inspection reports clearly separated from observed ones. It complements data-ademe-dpe-energy-performance-diagnostics and data-bdnb-base-de-donnees-nationale-des-batiments by joining them into a local risk workflow. A caveat is that reported risk signals are software outputs requiring inspector review, not measured failure probabilities.
licence: MIT for repository code; ADEME, RNB, BDNB, AQC and other source data retain their own terms.
